HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

2. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.
   B. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
